'''Black Lance's Last Strike''' is a [[sword form]]. It is a simple form, depending entirely upon speed to draw a sword from the scabbard and thrust it into the enemy's neck. It is, however, an all-or-nothing move; if it fails, the swordsman usually dies.

[[Gareth Bryne]] used this form to kill an assassin sneaking up on [[Siuan Sanche]] during the [[Seanchan]] [[Battle of Tar Valon|raid]] on the [[White Tower]]. The assassin was a Seanchan [[Bloodknife]].{{ref/book|12|41}}

==Parallel==
The real-world parallel is found the Japanese ''{{Wiki|iaido}}''.
